name: Certificates and domains
author: NetMaster
description: Warns before the TLS certificates on your web services (NAS, router, home server, websites) and your domain names expire. Works with self-signed certificates in the home network too. Domain dates come straight from the registry (RDAP or WHOIS), no account needed.

settings.label: Addresses to check
settings.help: Separate with commas or spaces. A name or IP, with :port when it is not 443. For example: nas.local:5001, 192.168.1.1, example.com

settings.label: Also check my monitored services
settings.help: The https:// addresses in Services to monitor (Settings).

settings.label: Domains to check
settings.help: Your domain names, for example example.com. Separate with commas or spaces.

actions.label: Check now
actions.help: Checks every certificate and domain right away.
